_what_this_is: PRE-REGISTERED FORWARD TEST of RELATIVE VOLUME as a DAY-SELECTION filter — the first selection filter of any kind this desk has ever run. Registered 2026-09-13; START IS DELAYED, see below.
registered_by: operator: 'run the relvol filter forward too'

the_finding.measured: single-lot live book, 31 sessions after the 14-session warm-up, roll-excluded
the_finding.shape: MONOTONE DECREASING in all three windows independently, and the quietest quintile is +$20 to +$31/trade

\u2605_it_runs_BACKWARDS_to_the_literatu: The published dose-response INCREASES with relative volume (-0.02R / +0.08R / +0.38R, Crabel 1990 and replicated since). It was measured on BREAKOUTS, which need participation to follow through. This desk's only green live gate is capitulation_long, a REVERSION gate, which needs the opposite: a quiet tape that mean-reverts rather than trends. The sign flip is therefore a PREDICTION of the mechanism, not an anomaly — and it independently predicts this desk's own banked memory, 'DON'T BENCH A COILED GATE ON QUIET TAPE'.

the_rule.feature: RelVol(30) = volume in the first 30 minutes of the US session (13:30-14:00Z) / the mean of the same window over the trailing 14 sessions
the_rule.window_choice: 30 minutes, FROZEN. It is the median of the three tested and matches the opening-range period the practitioner literature uses. Choosing it because it scored best would be fitting; all three are logged every session so the choice can be AUDITED later, but only the 30-minute value acts.
the_rule.threshold: RelVol > 1.00 -> BENCH. Not a fitted parameter: 1.00 is the natural boundary of the ratio, i.e. 'busier than the trailing average'. The measured HIGH bucket began at 1.01.
the_rule.evaluated_at: 14:00Z, once. It cannot be known earlier - the first 30 minutes must finish.
the_rule.action: bench all six tournament gates for the remainder of the session. Writes `off`, never `on`.
what_it_does_NOT_do: act on trades already open or already taken before 14:00Z

\u26a0\u26a0_WHY_THE_START_IS_DELAYED.problem: The denominator is a trailing 14-session volume mean and capture.db.bars HAS NO CONTRACT COLUMN. The MNQ contract rolled MNQU6 -> MNQZ6 on 2026-09-13, and first-30-min volume fell 0.79x across the trailing window as the September contract died. After the roll, volume on the new front month jumps back — so RelVol would read ~1.3-1.5 on EVERY session for 14 sessions and the filter would bench every day for a reason that has nothing to do with participation.
\u26a0\u26a0_WHY_THE_START_IS_DELAYED.also: 2026-09-07 (US Labor Day) sits in the baseline at 32,242 against a ~292,697 mean — a tenth of normal. A holiday in the denominator inflates every subsequent ratio.
\u26a0\u26a0_WHY_THE_START_IS_DELAYED.decision: FIRST ELIGIBLE SESSION IS THE 15TH CLEAN POST-ROLL SESSION, on or about 2026-10-02. Until then the script LOGS RelVol every session and acts on nothing, so the warm-up is observable rather than assumed.
\u26a0\u26a0_WHY_THE_START_IS_DELAYED.build_item: add a contract column to capture.db.bars so this is fixable properly rather than waited out. Until it exists, EVERY volume ratio on this desk is roll-blind.

verdict_rule.primary: mean $/trade on ACTED sessions (RelVol <= 1.00) beats mean $/trade on BENCHED sessions, day-clustered 95% CI on the difference excluding zero
verdict_rule.REFUTED: the benched sessions are as profitable as the acted ones - the filter is decoration
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than 20 sessions in either bucket by session 60
verdict_rule._a_second_reading_that_matters: if the filter is neutral on $/trade but cuts trade COUNT materially, it still wins on friction - report that separately.

rules_of_engagement: DO NOT change the window from 30 minutes.
DO NOT start before the 15th clean post-roll session, however tempting the interim looks.
Log all three windows; act on one.
The 31-session measurement is where the effect was FOUND. Its P&L is not a result.
